description: This Java class 'ContainerLoader' manages the lifecycle of containers (background processes) in the OFBiz framework, including loading, starting, and unloading containers based on configuration and startup commands.

classes.name: ContainerLoader
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, starting, and unloading container processes in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes and starts containers based on configuration and startup commands.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Stops all loaded containers during shutdown.
